Metadata.title: X Home Easy — decide on a wired estate system before you sign
Metadata.description: A neutral decision aid for villa owners in the United States and Canada. Sources, a budget range, and the questions to ask an integrator — with no paid ranking.

Home.eyebrow: For villas and estates in the United States and Canada
Home.title: Work out whether a wired estate system suits this house — before the contract is signed.
Home.lede: X Home Easy is a neutral decision aid for Control4, Crestron, Savant, and Lutron. You read a budget range, check the source of every statement, and ask an integrator the questions that become expensive later. A paid membership does not change the order of integrators.
Home.accountHelpTitle: The phone and the website belong together
Home.accountHelp: In the app you choose owner or integrator. Owners give the street; the house number stays in the account until a specific request. A claimed integrator listing can show a street. The house number is not on the public directory. Search widens from 5 to 500 miles in the United States, or kilometres in Canada, and then stops. Payment does not change the order.
Home.pathTitle: How you get from the question to the installation.
Home.pathLede: A licensed integrator builds the system. X Home Easy makes the decision and the request complete. The path is open on this page. Line-voltage wiring and dealer programming steps are not here.
Home.guideYou: You read which step provides which help.
Home.guideGet: You see that the installation belongs to a contractor and the app prepares the request.
Home.examplesYou: You open five houses when you want a comparison.
Home.examplesGet: An outline and the next questions. Not a quote, and not the start.
Home.fitYou: You state the house, the building phase, the budget, DIY, and freedom to change supplier.
Home.fitGet: A direction among a wired host, a retail system, or a hybrid. Every cell has a source. No mark for a company.
Home.roomsYou: You choose functions per room, not device channels.
Home.roomsGet: Good, Better, or Best, and the published house range with a source. No single price.
Home.requestYou: You ask for a split total and for the project files, passwords, and admin accounts before the final payment.
Home.requestGet: A request a contractor can answer. That is the implementation support.
Home.partnersYou: The list follows distance, official rank, checked projects, and response time.
Home.partnersGet: No paid order. An unclaimed Silver entry shows no contact details.
Home.quotesYou: You compare hardware, programming hours, installation, and commissioning with documentation.
Home.quotesGet: A missing promise on the file or the key file is marked in red.
Home.handoverYou: You walk a list before signing and at handover.
Home.handoverGet: An information sheet. Not legal advice.
Home.workYou: The registered contractor installs, programs, and hands over.
Home.workGet: X Home Easy does not describe the wiring or the dealer programming steps for that.
Home.stepsTitle: Three steps before anyone writes a quote
Home.step1Body: The house, the building phase, and your expectations are set out plainly. This is not a mark for a company and not an overall score.
Home.step2Body: You choose functions room by room. Not actuator channels, and not devices from one manufacturer's catalogue.
Home.step3Body: A standard request can later go to up to three partners. The list follows distance, official rank, checked projects, and response time.
Home.evidenceTitle: Every statement carries a source grade
Home.evidenceLede: The grade is a shape and a word. Colour does not carry the meaning on its own. A click opens the source and the date it was checked.
Home.silverExample: Example: a Silver partner with no claim on the profile. Email, phone, and street address are not shown.
Home.budgetNote: A published band for a roughly 5,000–8,000 ft² house with Control4 and a Lutron base is $50,000–$120,000 (trade press, reviewed 2026-10-21). Not a quote.
Home.rankingBody: The order uses only distance, listing rank, the number of checked projects, and response time. A paid subscription does not change this order. A paid placement would stand apart and be labelled Sponsored.
Home.dbAwaitingKey: The Supabase project is on file. The public API key is still missing, so this page stays signed out.

Facts.standardBody: The company page cites 500,000+ homes, about 6,000 authorized integrators, and 25,000+ third-party devices. That is a manufacturer statement, not a share of this house.
Facts.catalogueTitle: Lutron HomeWorks is a lighting and shade base
Facts.catalogueBody: HomeWorks is the usual lighting and shade base beside a control host. A high CEDIA mention share is not a statistic that every house uses it.
Facts.countTitle: The professional channel is not the retail one
Facts.countBody: CEDIA’s 2026 research, as reported by CE Pro, puts U.S. residential technology integration at about $33.8 billion. That is the professional channel, not a count of every dealer.
Facts.budgetTitle: A published whole-home band, not a bid
Facts.budgetBody: Trade press reviewed on 2026-10-21 describes about $50,000–$120,000 for Control4 plus a Lutron base on a 5,000–8,000 ft² house. Savant is often described as $20,000–$40,000 higher, and Crestron Home about $80,000–$180,000. Not a quote.
Facts.rankingTitle: Listing rank is Silver, Gold, or Platinum
Facts.rankingBody: A new claimed profile starts at Silver. An unclaimed Silver entry shows no email and no street. Payment does not change the order.
Facts.handoverTitle: Control4 can change integrator after OvrC
Facts.handoverBody: After the project is transferred in OvrC, the household can change Smart Home Pro at customer.control4.com. Crestron and Savant do not use that page. Their files and subscriptions belong in the contract.

Safety.heading: Electrical safety and limits
Safety.nav: In the United States and Canada, line-voltage work on the premises belongs to an electrician licensed for that state or province. There is no single federal licence that replaces that check.
Safety.partP: Low-voltage design still follows the local rule and the manufacturer. The integrator does not become the electrician because a control system is involved.
Safety.boundary: X Home Easy does not describe line-voltage wiring, electrical-panel layouts, or steps inside Composer Pro, Configure Pro, or Savant dealer tools. That work belongs to a licensed electrician or an authorized integrator.
Safety.disclaimerZh: 仅供参考，不构成法律意见。
Safety.disclaimerEn: For informational purposes only; does not constitute legal advice.
Safety.trademark: Control4, Crestron, Savant, Lutron, and CEDIA are trademarks of their respective owners. X Home Easy is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.lede: The website does not create accounts. In the app, save an email and password first. Apple sign-in alone does not open the website. We do not check that the mailbox is real. This page then accepts the same email and password. Owners see the same studio as the app. Integrator salespeople go to the integrator workbench.
Login.ownerHelp: After signing in, the owner manages the project in the browser. Street and house number stay in the account.
Login.installerHelp: After signing in, the integrator can manage the account in the browser. Listing rank does not come from this form, and the monthly fee does not change the order.
Login.expired: Sign in again with the email and password saved in the app.
Login.emailLede: Use the email and password saved in the app. The account’s role decides the next screen.
Login.emailFailed: The email or password was not recognised.
Login.scanLede: Use the email and password saved in the app. The account’s role decides the next screen.
Login.manageLede: The same work as in the app: describe the house, keep the account, and see contractors by distance. Payment stays on the iPhone.
Login.needSession: Sign in with the email and password saved in the app.
Login.paymentOnlyApple: Unlocked files are set only by an Apple purchase on the iPhone.

Account.helpTitle: How the phone and the website belong together
Account.help: Save the website account in the app with an email and password. The website accepts only that email and password. The owner’s house number stays in the account. A claimed integrator listing can show a street. The house number is not on the public directory. Search runs from 5 through 500 miles in the United States, or kilometres in Canada, and then stops.

Account.syncFailed: The account was not fully transferred.
Account.saved: Website account saved. Sign in with this email and password.
Account.scanInvalid: Sign in with the email and password saved in the app.
Account.scanRole: Sign in with the email and password saved in the app. The saved role opens the matching desk.
Account.scanNeedsAccount: Create the website account with email and password in the app first.
Account.scanFailed: The email or password was not recognised.
Account.camera: The website signs in with email and password.

Help.lede: The way of working comes first, then the charges. $129 once per project and $129 per month are fixed product prices. They are not calculated from the house.
Help.settingsLede: The same comparison is in the help, directly under the way of working.
Help.flowLede: The centre is the request. The owner is on the left, the contractor on the right. Payment comes after saving, not before. A registered contractor builds the system.

Help.paymentBody: The owner pays $129 once for one project. The integrator pays $129 per month. Both are paid only on the iPhone with the Apple account. The website does not take payment. Only the confirmation from the in-app purchase turns the unlock on. A switch on the website cannot do that by itself.
Help.founding: Early founding partners do not pay the monthly fee for the first six months. The mark sits on the profile and does not change the order.
Help.sponsored: A paid placement, if one appears later, stands apart and is labelled Sponsored.
Help.priceNote: $129 once and $129 per month are the fixed product prices. No calculation and no language model sets them.

bodies.guide: You read which step prepares which help. The installation stays with a registered electrical contractor. The app prepares the decision and the request.
bodies.examples: Five houses sit one level under the introduction. A card can be hidden on this device and restored. A case is not a quote and not the start.
bodies.fit: The app reads a fixed word list, not a language model, then asks only for the open point. Each comparison cell keeps its source. There is no score for a contractor.
bodies.rooms: You choose functions per room. Not actuator channels and not devices from a catalogue. Good, Better, or Best sits beside the published house range. That range is not the price of this house.
bodies.request: The request asks for a split sum, and for the project files, passwords, and admin accounts before the last payment. Writing and saving the draft is free. Exporting the PDF is part of the Project Pro Pass.
bodies.account: Save the website account in the app with an email and password. The website accepts only that email and password. The owner's house number stays in the account until a specific request needs it. A claimed integrator listing can show a street. The house number is not on the public directory. Search runs from 5 through 10, 20, 50, 100, and 200 up to 500 miles in the United States, or kilometres in Canada, and then stops.
bodies.partners: The order uses only distance, official rank, checked projects, and response time. A payment does not move anyone up. An unclaimed Silver entry shows no email, no phone, and no street.
bodies.quotes: Up to three quotes are read by hardware, programming hours, installation, and commissioning with documentation. A missing promise for the project file or the admin account is marked. This comparison is part of the Project Pro Pass.
bodies.handover: A list before signature and at handover. It is part of the Project Pro Pass.
bodies.work: A licensed integrator installs, programs, and hands over. X Home Easy does not describe the wiring or the dealer programming steps.
bodies.settings: Apple sign-in on the phone is only the identity on this device. Signing out leaves the drafts here. Deleting removes the copies on this device. After payment, the unlock sits on the project, not on the Apple sign-in.
bodies.safety: No line-voltage instructions, no electrical-panel layout, and no dealer-tool steps. In the United States and Canada that work stays with an electrician licensed for the state or province, and with an authorized integrator.

AiAct.label: AI transparency notice
AiAct.heading: You are talking to an on-device advisor
AiAct.body: When the X Home Easy advisor replies, you are talking to an advisor. Replies should rest on checked sources and name them. This notice is marked for the page. It is not a legal opinion or a permit.

Examples.title: Five houses to read afterwards
Examples.lede: These cases sit below the introduction. They do not replace the path to a request. On this device you can remove a card and bring it back later.
Examples.empty: Every example is hidden on this device. You can show them again.
Examples.openScheme: Open the outline and the next steps
Examples.pointsTitle: How a partner would take it forward
Examples.budgetMissing: Not stated. That is why there is no High, Medium, or Low fit.
Examples.storedLocally: Hiding applies only in this browser.
Examples.budgetContext: Trade press reviewed on 2026-10-21 describes about $50,000–$120,000 for a Control4 project with a Lutron base on a 5,000–8,000 ft² house. Not a quote.
Examples.areaAbove: The stated floor area is above the 120 to 250 square metre band. The range above is the published comparison, not the price of this house.
Examples.noHousePrice: The detached-house range is not shown here. It would otherwise be read as a price for this building.
Examples.basalteNote: Basalte is the specified wall keypad. A public KNX case pairs Basalte Sentido with a Control4 interface. That is a requested finish, not a unit price, and it is not rewritten as Lutron.
Examples.handoverNote: Before the final payment, the project files, passwords, and admin accounts for the selected brand belong in the handover. For Control4 that includes OvrC and customer.control4.com. For Crestron it includes whether the job is Crestron Home or SIMPL.
Examples.limit: For informational purposes only; this is not legal advice. No line-voltage instructions, no electrical-panel layout, and no dealer-tool steps.

tier.better: Better, the usual direction for a new house
tier.best: Best, because energy or a whole estate was asked for

wiring.open_with_shell: Shell still open: have low-voltage cable laid with the electrical installation
wiring.closed_finished: Walls closed: do not assume every cable run is opened
wiring.multi_building: Several buildings: the link belongs in the partner’s design
wiring.unspecified: Building phase missing: no statement about low-voltage cable yet

villa-family.title: New villa, 600 m², large garden
villa-family.story: A middle-aged couple has bought a new villa. Two children, two dogs, a 1,500 m² garden. Budget and any preference about changing supplier later were not stated.

renovation-care.title: Villa lived in for 30 years, 300 m²
renovation-care.story: Two older people are renovating the house they have lived in for 30 years. They want intrusion alerts, cues for daily life, and more comfortable room climate. Today there is a simple infrared alarm.

estate-outdoor.title: Estate over 2,000 m², several houses
estate-outdoor.story: The owners want a complete system, especially garden lighting and sound and picture on the terraces. The floor area covers more than one house.

hotel-rooms.title: Hotel, more than 300 rooms
hotel-rooms.story: A hotel-standard property wants stable, well-finished control in the rooms, plus use from an iPhone or iPad and by voice. This is not a single-family house.

designer-energy.title: Small villa, energy and switch range
designer-energy.story: A young designer wants energy in view and states a low-carbon or zero-carbon aim. The wall switches should be Basalte. Floor area, budget, and building phase are missing.

reasons.new_build_bus_with_mains: New build, still in design: the low-voltage pathways can be laid with the electrical installation during the shell. The registered contractor decides that.
reasons.area_above_typical_band: The floor area is over 250 m². This aid does not print a separate price for that.
reasons.garden_outside_room_cards: The garden is not a room in the house questions. Outdoor lighting is its own package.
reasons.budget_not_stated: Without a budget there is no High, Medium, or Low fit. Those rules need a stated range and a position on being free to change supplier.
reasons.lock_in_not_stated: It was not said whether any later contractor should be able to work on the project.
reasons.walls_already_closed: The house has been lived in for decades. The walls are closed. A new bus in every room is not the starting point.
reasons.existing_ir_alarm: The existing infrared alarm stays visible in the enquiry instead of being quietly replaced.
reasons.care_is_not_a_diagnosis: A call point and presence are comfort and cue functions. X Home Easy does not make a health diagnosis and does not recommend a medical device.
reasons.several_buildings: Several houses are not one detached house.
reasons.outdoor_light_and_av: Garden lighting, and sound and picture on the terrace, are separate trades, not a living-room card.
reasons.house_band_does_not_apply: The published house range does not apply here.
reasons.hotel_outside_model: More than 300 hotel rooms sit outside the decision aid for a house.
reasons.apple_voice_not_verified: iPhone, iPad, and voice are a requirement. There is no checked statement here that a particular gateway provides them.
reasons.finish_is_a_requirement: How the controls look belongs in the enquiry, not in a mark for a company.
reasons.energy_sits_in_best: Meters, photovoltaic, and a charge point sit in the Best direction. That is scope, not a carbon result.
reasons.plate_brand_is_basalte: The switch range is specified: Basalte.
reasons.zero_carbon_not_a_result: A low-carbon aim is a target for the building. The controls alone do not calculate it.
reasons.phase_not_stated: Without the building phase it stays open whether a bus can still go in during the shell.

functions.dim_living: Dimming in living rooms, not a list of actuator channels.
functions.room_climate: Temperature per room. The heating and cooling contractor plans the plant.
functions.outdoor_lighting: Light in the garden or along paths, as its own package for the partner.
functions.terrace_av: Sound and picture on the terrace, as a requirement for the partner, not a cabling plan.
functions.intrusion_alert: An alert on unauthorised entry, tied to the existing or the new system.
functions.call_point: A call point on the routes the household uses every day.
functions.night_presence: Restrained presence at night, as a cue, not as watching a person.
functions.energy_metering: Meters for the large loads, readable by the household.
functions.pv_ev: Coordinate photovoltaic and a charge point only if both are being built.
functions.basalte_plates: Basalte wall switches, as the finish in the enquiry.
functions.guest_room_light: Light per guest room, consistent and readable by the staff.
functions.guest_controls: Controls a guest can understand. Apple and voice stay an open question for the specifier.
functions.scenes: A few scenes, named for daily life, not for group addresses.
functions.record_existing_alarm: Describe the old infrared alarm as part of the existing installation.
functions.guest_room_climate: Climate per room, stable in continuous use.
functions.stable_operation: Operation over years, with a documented handover, not a single scene button.
functions.climate_per_building: Climate per building, not one flat template for the whole estate.

points.bus_during_shell: Have low-voltage cable laid during the shell, together with the electrical installation.
points.garden_as_own_package: Specify the garden and paths as their own package, not as another living room.
points.pets_not_devices: Dogs do not turn the brief into a device list. The partner describes gates and outdoor light.
points.ets_handover: Require the project files, the passwords, and the admin accounts for the selected brand before the final payment.
points.no_wiring_steps: No cable routes, no consumer unit, and no programming steps from this page.
points.prefer_rf_or_short_routes: Look first at short routes and, where the wall is closed, at radio links.
points.do_not_strip_all_walls: Do not open every wall for new low-voltage cable.
points.climate_by_qualified_trade: Heating and cooling stay with the trade qualified for them.
points.write_old_alarm_into_request: Write the existing infrared alarm into the enquiry.
points.separate_project_per_building: Keep a separate project and a separate handover for each house.
points.outdoor_specified_by_partner: The partner specifies outdoor light, sound, and picture, including weather and ingress protection.
points.no_bus_layout_from_us: This aid does not draw the link between the buildings.
points.handover_per_building: Hand over the file, password, and key file per building.
points.do_not_print_house_price: Do not use the $50,000 to $120,000 published band as the price of this building.
points.apple_voice_as_question: Put iPhone, iPad, and voice in the enquiry as a question, not as a promised feature.
points.not_a_three_quote_house: Do not treat this as three house quotes for a hotel.
points.documentation_handover: Still require documentation and access in the contract.
points.qualified_contractor: The work is carried out only by the contractor licensed for it.
points.put_brand_in_request: Put Basalte in the enquiry as the required switch range.
points.carbon_needs_the_building: Settle the carbon aim with the architecture and the building services, not with a controls figure.
points.no_bus_promise_without_phase: Without the building phase, do not promise that a bus can still be laid during the shell.

Workbench.metaDescription: Claim a listed company or apply to add one. Pending applications stay off the public directory.
Workbench.title: Integrator workbench
Workbench.lede: Claim a company already in the directory, or apply to add your own. The application stays pending until X Home Easy staff approves it. A pending application is not in the public directory.
Workbench.applyLede: This page is for an integrator who already has a website account. It does not create an account. New accounts are created in the app, under Settings, Website account.
Workbench.needSession: Sign in with the website account you created in the app. This page does not register a new account.
Workbench.notInstaller: This workbench is for a profile whose role is integrator. Owners stay in Manage. The application form cannot switch you to staff.
Workbench.profileError: The profile could not be read. Nothing was submitted or changed.
Workbench.listingHelp: This is your directory row, plus any application that is still pending. Pending rows are not public.
Workbench.listingEmpty: You do not have a directory row yet. A pending application is not shown in the public directory.
Workbench.listingFailed: The listing could not be loaded. This is not an empty listing.
Workbench.planLock: Partner Workbench Pro is $129 per month and Project Pro Pass is $129 once. Both stay locked until a later Apple confirmation. This website does not charge and does not unlock them.
Workbench.contactPrivate: The listing email is not public.
Workbench.claimsHelp: Applications you submitted, and their status. Staff approve or reject them. You cannot approve your own.
Workbench.claimsFailed: The applications could not be loaded. This is not an empty list.
Workbench.incomingHelp: Another account asked to claim this company. Staff make the decision. This list does not show that account’s email or a house number.
Workbench.noApplications: You have not submitted an application.
Workbench.noIncoming: No other account has a claim on your listing.
Workbench.ordersHelp: These are requests and quotes addressed to your company. They are not payments. No homeowner request is delivered yet, because projects stay locked.
Workbench.ordersEmpty: No request has been delivered. Homeowner delivery is not open.
Workbench.ordersFailed: Requests could not be loaded. This is not an empty list.
Workbench.replyCap: A free integrator account is limited to 2 replies a year. This screen does not raise that cap and does not mark a project as unlocked.
Workbench.streetHelp: Do not enter a house number. The house number is not published on the directory, on requests, or on integrator lists.
Workbench.directoryEmpty: The public directory returned no company to claim. You can still apply to add one.
Workbench.directoryFailed: The directory could not be loaded. The claim list below is not the directory.
Workbench.unavailable: The database connection is not configured. Nothing was submitted.
Workbench.listingUnknown: Your current listing could not be checked, so a new company was not submitted.
Workbench.missing: Company, city, state or province, postal code, and the United States or Canada are required.
Workbench.pickMissing: Choose a company from the directory.
Workbench.saved: Submitted. The application is pending and is not in the public directory.
Workbench.submitted: Your application is pending. It is not in the public directory.
Workbench.duplicate: You already have a pending application of this kind.
Workbench.target: That company is not in the public directory.
Workbench.alreadyListed: This account already has a directory row. A second company was not submitted.
Workbench.hasListing: You already have a directory row, so this form will not add a second company. You can still claim a company that is already listed.
Workbench.roleDenied: Only an integrator profile can submit this. New accounts are created in the app.
Workbench.notStaff: This form cannot make you an admin. Staff access is assigned in the database.
Workbench.claimCaution: A listed company has one claimant. If an account has already claimed it, this form does not make you a second claimant.
Workbench.silverHidden: Unclaimed Silver: email and street stay hidden on the public directory.
Workbench.cardPhoto: Photo of your company business card
Workbench.officePhoto: Photo of you in an office that shows the company logo
Workbench.evidenceHelp: A claim needs the business-card photo, your personal company email, and the office photo. Extra evidence is optional.
Workbench.evidencePrivate: The files go to a private bucket. Only you and staff can read them. The public directory does not show them.
Workbench.alreadyClaimed: An account with the email {email} has already claimed this company. Contact them first. If there is a dispute, submit more evidence and staff will step in. A dispute stays pending and does not create a second claimant.
Workbench.evidenceMissing: The business-card photo, office photo, and personal company email are required.
Workbench.notDisputable: A dispute can be filed only when another account has already claimed that company.

Admin.metaDescription: Staff tools for users, integrator applications, and requests.
Admin.title: Staff
Admin.lede: Track website users, integrator applications, and requests. This is not a payment console.
Admin.assignment: An admin row is set in the database by X Home Easy staff. The application form cannot grant this role, and this page has no control that promotes your own account.
Admin.deniedBody: Staff access is assigned in the database. Signing in as an owner or an integrator does not open this page, and the application form cannot make you an admin.
Admin.unconfigured: The database connection is not configured, so staff access cannot be checked. Nothing was approved.
Admin.configTitle: The server key is not configured
Admin.configBody: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is missing. Approval was not saved.
Admin.usersConfig: Email addresses are not shown, because the server key is not configured. Roles and countries below come from profiles the staff account can read.
Admin.usersError: The account list could not be loaded. This is not an empty directory.
Admin.truncated: Showing the first {count} accounts returned by the auth service.
Admin.usersHelp: Email, role, country, and registration time. House numbers are not listed.
Admin.integratorsHelp: Integrator accounts and the company name on the registration. House numbers are not listed.
Admin.progressHelp: Request and quote progress. These rows are not payments.
Admin.progressLocked: Delivery is still locked. This table is request and quote progress, not payment. There are no request rows to show, and none are invented.
Admin.progressEmpty: Delivery is open, and no request rows were returned.
Admin.progressError: The request progress could not be loaded. This is not an empty list.
Admin.awardsHelp: Awarded or selected quotes only. Nothing here is invented.
Admin.awardsEmpty: No awarded or selected quote yet.
Admin.awardsError: Awarded quotes could not be loaded. This is not an empty list.
Admin.communicationsHelp: Key notes between a homeowner and an integrator. Not payments, and not a house number.
Admin.communicationsEmpty: No key messages between owners and integrators yet.
Admin.communicationsError: The communication list could not be loaded. This is not an empty list.
Admin.disputeWarning: Approve records this dispute only. It does not make the applicant a second claimant.
Admin.accountLede: Staff sign-in uses an account name. The public sign-in page stays email and password.
Admin.accountHelp: Type the account name admin. This page maps that name to the staff mailbox. It does not accept a public email here.
Admin.name: Name
Admin.streetHelp: This is not a published house number. The public directory does not show a house number.
Admin.pendingPublic: Pending applications are not in the public directory. Approving a new company creates a Silver, free listing with contact details kept private. Approving a claim sets the account on that row only when nobody else has claimed it.
Admin.leadsHelp: These rows are requests and quotes to an integrator, not payments. The list may be empty because homeowner delivery is not open.
Admin.forbidden: Staff access is assigned in the database. This decision was not saved.
Admin.claimed: This company is already claimed. The account on that row was not changed.
Admin.alreadyListed: This account already has a listing. A second directory row was not created.
Admin.notPending: This application is no longer pending. Nothing new was approved.
Admin.notFound: That application or company was not found.
Admin.roleBlock: The applicant is not an integrator. No directory row was created.
Admin.missing: The decision was incomplete and was not saved.
